description: This file defines a mock class DispatcherMock used for unit testing, which mocks the interface WPEFramework::PluginHost::ILocalDispatcher. It utilizes Google Mock framework macros to declare mock methods corresponding to the interface's pure virtual functions.

classes.name: DispatcherMock
classes.description: A mock class implementing the ILocalDispatcher interface for testing purposes, providing mock implementations of its methods.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Mocks incrementing the reference count, returning a uint32_t.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Mocks decrementing the reference count, returning a uint32_t.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks querying for a specific interface by its number, returning a void pointer.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Mocks activating the dispatcher with a given service shell.

methods.name: Dropped
methods.description: Mocks notification that a dispatcher has dropped.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Mocks invoking a method on the dispatcher with given channel, id, token, method, parameters, and response.

methods.name: Invoke (overload)
methods.description: Mocks invoking a callback with specified parameters, returning a HRESULT.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Mocks validating a token and method with parameters, returning HRESULT.

methods.name: Local
methods.description: Mocks returning a pointer to a local dispatcher.
